study.title: Checkout Decision Study
study.goal: Understand why a shopper considered a product but did not complete checkout and identify the smallest useful follow-up test.
decisionQuestions: Which barriers appear most often in this sample?
Which product, price, trust, or checkout improvement should be tested next?

audience.description: Synthetic adult shopper personas who considered a product and left before completing checkout.
eligibility: Reached a product or checkout page

claims.text: The image and checkout details in this fixture are synthetic and do not describe a live offer.
claims.source: Synthetic fixture created for local acceptance testing on 2026-08-31

en.title: Review how this synthetic study uses your answers
en.intro: This optional screen is dormant unless a specific project explicitly enables it.
items: Written answers are stored in a local test database and processed by the configured AI provider.
Do not enter names, contact details, order numbers, or payment details.
en.checkbox: I understand and want to start this synthetic study.

dataPolicy.providerDisclosure: Answers are processed by a configured third-party AI provider for interview understanding, controlled follow-up, and evidence extraction.

fields.description: What the participant hoped to accomplish
Reasons for not completing the purchase
Confidence in the decision not to buy
Information or reassurance that was missing
Change that could make the participant reconsider

anchors.question: What started your search for the product?

anchors.label: Main barriers
anchors.objective: Identify the barriers that materially affected the purchase decision.
anchors.question: What influenced your decision to leave?
anchors.clarification: What influenced your decision to leave?
sufficiencyCriteria: At least one decision-relevant barrier is recorded
highValueProbeTargets: A barrier not represented in the choices

anchors.objective: Capture a post-conversation confidence measure while preserving its position as a possible intervention effect.
